region: North Africa slice of the P1 world grid: Tunisia and Algeria, coastal Tell north of 34N

areas.name: Petite Kabylie
areas.why: Fills the coastal gap between Kabylie (ends 5.2E) and NE Algeria (starts 7.0E). Jijel and the Petite Kabylie oak forests burn in the same summer season, the box stays north of 36.4N, and it does not overlap the other three.
